onboarding.title: Set up JobHunter
onboarding.brandSub: Three steps and it starts working for you
onboarding.step1.title: Upload your CV
onboarding.step1.lead: Everything else is filled in from it — and it gets attached to every application you send. It stays in this browser and is never uploaded anywhere.
onboarding.drop: Drop your CV here, or click to choose
onboarding.dropFormats: PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown · up to 8 MB
onboarding.foundNothing: No contact details found — you can add them later in Settings.
onboarding.found.name: Name
onboarding.step2.title: What are you looking for?
onboarding.step2.lead: Job titles matter most — they carry 40 of the 100 match points.
onboarding.where.help: Write Remote for remote roles, or Worldwide if location does not matter.
onboarding.step3.title: Which industries?
onboarding.step3.lead: This picks which company career pages get watched. Leave it empty and JobHunter searches the open job boards only — that already covers most of the world.
onboarding.searchingLead: Going through job boards and company career pages. Takes about half a minute.
onboarding.doneLead: Went through {seen} postings in {seconds} seconds. From now on this runs by itself, twice a day.
onboarding.doneLeadNone: No matches yet with these filters. Try adding more job titles or widening your locations.
onboarding.failed: Could not finish the first search
onboarding.failedLead: Check your internet connection and try again from the dashboard.
fill.noFields: JobHunter did not recognise any fields on this page.
fill.check: Check everything, then press Submit yourself.
fill.nothingPrepared: Nothing prepared yet — open JobHunter and hit Apply on a match first.
notify.title: {n} jobs match you
error.alreadyApplied: You already applied to this one
settings.update.title: Updates
settings.update.help: Chrome never loads code from the internet — it reads the files on your disk. Run update.bat to pull the latest changes, then press this button to restart the extension with them.
